title: Management pages show translated states and reasons and never print nan or translation keys

reproduction.source: coordinator hosted reads 2026-11-20 (read-only; BFF fb8ed951d; sweep of 67 pages in /home/chloe_ong_dev_cctech_support_com/claude-evidence/mgmt-readability-sweep-20261120/full/)

findings_reproduced.observed: Resolved incidents rendered a green 成功 badge because Operations.tsx:594 and :621 mapped r.status === 'resolved' to 'success'.
Status and outcome values completed, executed, canceled, refused, convened, and insufficient_participants rendered untranslated.
Runtimes.tsx defined const NAN = 'nan' and rendered five unsupported telemetry columns (CPU, Memory, p95 latency, Uptime, Region) printing nan five times per row.

CapabilitiesLists.tsx:17 referenced capabilities.actions.disabledReason which was missing from both zh-TW.ts and en-US.ts, causing ObjectListPage.tsx:329 to print the raw key capabilities.actions.disabledReason.

PersonaFleetPage in oversight/_core.tsx:1287-1296 rendered status, stage, and failureReason inline without spaces or translation, producing failedobserving(tool_record_unavailable:no_proposal_submitted).

OpenClawLlmAuthPanel.tsx rendered raw reason codes answer_probe_not_run, codex_mount_missing_credentials, claude_mount_missing_credentials, claude_auth_probe_non_zero_exit, and provider_snapshot without plain-language explanation.
LineageGraph.tsx rendered raw edge types source_strategy_spec, source_run, capital_pool and raw node state approved.
HumanInboxPage in oversight/_core.tsx:1577 rendered multi-hundred-character DriftReport summaries unclamped without a 3-line clamp or expand control.

changes_summary.shared_helper: src/lib/enumLabels.ts centralizes BFF enum localization and tone resolution across status, outcome, action, risk, reason code, and lineage edge type, and folds in PostmortemLibrary, governanceDecisionState, and Lists status/workflow mappings.
changes_summary.locales: src/i18n/locales/zh-TW.ts and src/i18n/locales/en-US.ts symmetrically define all status.*, risk.*, capabilities.*, common.notReported, mgmt.inbox.expandSummary/collapseSummary, and enumLabels.{outcomes,actions,reasons,lineageEdges}.* keys.
changes_summary.incidents: Operations.tsx passes r.status and active.status directly to StatusBadge so resolved incidents render 已解決 / Resolved and never 成功.
changes_summary.runtimes: Runtimes.tsx removes the NAN constant and the five unsupported telemetry columns (cpu, memory, p95 latency, uptime, region), and renders 未回報 / Not reported for missing values.
changes_summary.reasons: PersonaFleetPage (_core.tsx), OpenClawLlmAuthPanel.tsx, MeetingsCenterPage.tsx, and MeetingDetailPage.tsx render plain-language reason text with the raw code as secondary text.
changes_summary.capabilities: CapabilitiesLists.tsx and ObjectListPage.tsx render the localized capabilities.actions.disabledReason and guard against printing raw translation keys.
changes_summary.human_inbox: HumanInboxPage (_core.tsx) clamps card summary text to 3 lines (line-clamp-3) by default with an expand/collapse toggle control.
changes_summary.lineage: LineageGraph.tsx localizes edge labels and node states via enumLabels while keeping column-gap layout synchronized with displayed label width.

verification.typecheck: npm run typecheck:app && npm run typecheck:agora (0 errors)
verification.full_suite_totals: npm run test: 281 test files passed (281), 3256 tests passed (3256)

four_test_failure_decisions.test: src/management/pages/PersonaDetail.test.ts — renders canonical lifecycleStatus research_only instead of contradictory legacy draft state while preserving paper readiness
four_test_failure_decisions.rationale: StatusBadge now localizes research_only to 僅供研究 (zh-TW) / Research Only (en-US) via enumLabels instead of printing the raw untranslated enum research_only. Canonical lifecycleStatus still wins over legacy draft (草稿) and paper readiness (0/5, 未升級) is preserved.

four_test_failure_decisions.test: src/test/governance-owner-readonly-detail.test.tsx — displays canonical state as unknown and renders decision buttons non-actionable for unknown owner states
four_test_failure_decisions.rationale: In en-US, StatusBadge now renders localized Unknown (capitalized, matching Pending/Approved) for state='unknown' while the Canonical State mono field renders unknown and the decision panel renders 'Already unknown.' with approve/reject buttons non-actionable. Updated getAllByText to /^unknown$/i (>= 2).

four_test_failure_decisions.test: src/management/pages/CapitalPoolDetail.test.tsx — renders unavailable badges and placeholders when status and currency are missing or unknown
four_test_failure_decisions.rationale: StatusBadge.tsx had replaced the empty/missing state fallback with '—' instead of the unavailable label. Restored label ?? statusLabel('unavailable', t) ('無資料' in zh-TW, 'Unavailable' in en-US) when !cleanState so missing/unknown status and risk each render an Unavailable badge (2 total) and CapitalPoolDetail.test.tsx passes unchanged.

four_test_failure_decisions.test: src/management/pages/phase2/LineageExplorer.test.tsx — filters Strategy, Persona, Artifact, CapitalPool, Experiment, and Dataset nodes and removes incident edges while keeping unknown types visible and labelled
four_test_failure_decisions.rationale: LineageGraph.tsx localizes node state ('draft' -> '草稿' in zh-TW / 'Draft' in en-US) while keeping unknown node type feature_set visible and labelled (data-node-type='feature_set', text 'feature_set · 草稿'). Updated expectation to /feature_set · (草稿|Draft)/i.
